reasoning_traces.think:
The core bottleneck in FCI-family algorithms is the repeated testing of large conditioning sets, especially for rules requiring path enumeration. Block_paths_recursive optimizes by constructing separating sets directly from the graph topology rather than exhaustively testing adjacents. Circle-only path detection reduces a combinatorial search to a sparse graph connectivity query, exploiting the fact that oriented edges rarely participate in latent confounder signatures. Semidirected path checking for R10 avoids costly subset enumeration by analyzing the compositional structure of directed and semidirected triples. Together these primitives reduce the search space from exponential to linear in the neighborhood size, transforming a cubic scaling bottleneck into a nearly linear pass through the graph.
